title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
summary: A new study finds leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models, raising questions about preparedness as AI systems increasingly demonstrate unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior.
llm_summary: A new study shows that most leading AI labs still lack publicly documented strategies for restraining a “rogue” model—an AI that behaves unpredictably or dangerously. While the industry is racing to build ever more powerful systems, the research highlights a glaring gap in concrete, shared safety plans, raising concerns about how prepared we really are for out‑of‑control AI behavior.
